ConceptDef.label: the market guide
ConceptDef.helpText: Your market marker has a Guide button. It shows, step by step, what your market still needs on this map, with buttons to place each piece, and a page that explains why no caravan has come yet.

ConceptDef.label: market stalls
ConceptDef.helpText: A stall needs the merchant's spot at the end of its counter free, and a way in from the map edge. Paint its awning from here, or make it a colony stall to sell your own goods.

ConceptDef.label: market spots
ConceptDef.helpText: Pack animals wait at the caravan camp and off duty guards at the guard rest spot. Fence the camp in and the animals stay put. You can hide a spot once you know where it is.
